versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֱמֹ֥ר אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם לְנֶ֥פֶשׁ לֹֽא־יִטַּמָּ֖א בְּעַמָּֽיו׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people;
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:
controles.livre: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Fala aos sacerdotes filhos de Arão, e dize-lhes que não se contaminem por um morto em seus povos.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֚י אִם־לִשְׁאֵר֔וֹ הַקָּרֹ֖ב אֵלָ֑יו לְאִמּ֣וֹ וּלְאָבִ֔יו וְלִבְנ֥וֹ וּלְבִתּ֖וֹ וּלְאָחִֽיו׃

controles.web: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,
controles.kjv: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,
controles.livre: A não ser por seu parente próximo a si, por sua mãe, ou por seu pai, ou por seu filho, ou por seu irmão,

versos.hebraico: וְלַאֲחֹת֤וֹ הַבְּתוּלָה֙ הַקְּרוֹבָ֣ה אֵלָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־הָיְתָ֖ה לְאִ֑ישׁ לָ֖הּ יִטַּמָּֽא׃

controles.web: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.
controles.kjv: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.
controles.livre: ou por sua irmã virgem, a ele próxima, a qual não tenha tido marido, por ela se contaminará.

versos.hebraico: לֹ֥א יִטַּמָּ֖א בַּ֣עַל בְּעַמָּ֑יו לְהֵ֖חַלּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
controles.kjv: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
controles.livre: Porque é líder  em seu povo, não se contaminará, fazendo-se impuro.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־יקרחה קָרְחָה֙ בְּרֹאשָׁ֔ם וּפְאַ֥ת זְקָנָ֖ם לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֑חוּ וּבִ֨בְשָׂרָ֔ם לֹ֥א יִשְׂרְט֖וּ שָׂרָֽטֶת׃

controles.web: “‘They shall not shave their heads, neither shall they shave off the corners of their beards, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
controles.kjv: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
controles.livre: Não farão calva em sua cabeça, nem raparão a ponta de sua barba, nem em sua carne farão cortes.

versos.hebraico: קְדֹשִׁ֤ים יִהְיוּ֙ לֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֣א יְחַלְּל֔וּ שֵׁ֖ם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם כִּי֩ אֶת־אִשֵּׁ֨י יְהוָ֜ה לֶ֧חֶם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֛ם הֵ֥ם מַקְרִיבִ֖ם וְהָ֥יוּ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God; for they offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, the bread of their God; therefore they shall be holy.
controles.kjv: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.
controles.livre: Santos serão a seu Deus, e não profanarão o nome de seu Deus; porque oferecem os fogos do SENHOR e o pão de seu Deus; portanto, serão santos.

versos.hebraico: אִשָּׁ֨ה זֹנָ֤ה וַחֲלָלָה֙ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֔חוּ וְאִשָּׁ֛ה גְּרוּשָׁ֥ה מֵאִישָׁ֖הּ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֑חוּ כִּֽי־קָדֹ֥שׁ ה֖וּא לֵאלֹהָֽיו׃

controles.web: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane; neither shall they marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.
controles.kjv: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.
controles.livre: Mulher prostituta ou infame não tomarão: nem tomarão mulher repudiada de seu marido: porque é santo a seu Deus.

versos.hebraico: וְקִדַּשְׁתּ֔וֹ כִּֽי־אֶת־לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ ה֣וּא מַקְרִ֑יב קָדֹשׁ֙ יִֽהְיֶה־לָּ֔ךְ כִּ֣י קָד֔וֹשׁ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃

controles.web: You shall sanctify him therefore; for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you; for I Yahweh, who sanctify you, am holy.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the Lord, which sanctify you, am holy.
controles.livre: O santificarás portanto, pois o pão de teu Deus oferece: santo será para ti, porque santo sou eu o SENHOR vosso santificador.

versos.hebraico: וּבַת֙ אִ֣ישׁ כֹּהֵ֔ן כִּ֥י תֵחֵ֖ל לִזְנ֑וֹת אֶת־אָבִ֨יהָ֙ הִ֣יא מְחַלֶּ֔לֶת בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף׃ס

controles.web: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.
controles.kjv: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.
controles.livre: E a filha do homem sacerdote, se começar a se prostituir, a seu pai profana: queimada será ao fogo.

versos.hebraico: וְהַכֹּהֵן֩ הַגָּד֨וֹל מֵאֶחָ֜יו אֲֽשֶׁר־יוּצַ֥ק עַל־רֹאשׁ֣וֹ׀ שֶׁ֤מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֙ וּמִלֵּ֣א אֶת־יָד֔וֹ לִלְבֹּ֖שׁ אֶת־הַבְּגָדִ֑ים אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ֙ לֹ֣א יִפְרָ֔ע וּבְגָדָ֖יו לֹ֥א יִפְרֹֽם׃

controles.web: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, nor tear his clothes;
controles.kjv: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;
controles.livre: E o sumo sacerdote entre seus irmãos, sobre cuja cabeça foi derramado o azeite da unção, e que encheu sua mão para vestir as vestimentas, não descobrirá sua cabeça, nem romperá suas roupas:

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֛ל כָּל־נַפְשֹׁ֥ת מֵ֖ת לֹ֣א יָבֹ֑א לְאָבִ֥יו וּלְאִמּ֖וֹ לֹ֥א יִטַּמָּֽא׃

controles.web: neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
controles.kjv: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
controles.livre: nem entrará onde haja alguma pessoa morta, nem por seu pai, ou por sua mãe se contaminará.

versos.hebraico: וּמִן־הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ לֹ֣א יֵצֵ֔א וְלֹ֣א יְחַלֵּ֔ל אֵ֖ת מִקְדַּ֣שׁ אֱלֹהָ֑יו כִּ֡י נֵ֠זֶר שֶׁ֣מֶן מִשְׁחַ֧ת אֱלֹהָ֛יו עָלָ֖יו אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: nem sairá do santuário, nem contaminará o santuário de seu Deus; porque a coroa do azeite da unção de seu Deus está sobre ele: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְה֕וּא אִשָּׁ֥ה בִבְתוּלֶ֖יהָ יִקָּֽח׃

controles.web: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.
controles.kjv: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
controles.livre: E tomará ele mulher com sua virgindade.

versos.hebraico: אַלְמָנָ֤ה וּגְרוּשָׁה֙ וַחֲלָלָ֣ה זֹנָ֔ה אֶת־אֵ֖לֶּה לֹ֣א יִקָּ֑ח כִּ֛י אִם־בְּתוּלָ֥ה מֵעַמָּ֖יו יִקַּ֥ח אִשָּֽׁה׃

controles.web: A widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute, these he shall not marry: but a virgin of his own people shall he take as a wife.
controles.kjv: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.
controles.livre: Viúva, ou repudiada, ou infame, ou prostituta, estas não tomará: mas tomará virgem de seus povos por mulher.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹֽא־יְחַלֵּ֥ל זַרְע֖וֹ בְּעַמָּ֑יו כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ׃פ

controles.web: He shall not profane his seed among his people, for I am Yahweh who sanctifies him.’”
controles.kjv: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the Lord do sanctify him.
controles.livre: E não profanará sua descendência em seus povos; porque eu o SENHOR sou o que os santifico.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ מִֽזַּרְעֲךָ֞ לְדֹרֹתָ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה בוֹ֙ מ֔וּם לֹ֣א יִקְרַ֔ב לְהַקְרִ֖יב לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהָֽיו׃

controles.web: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your seed throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.
controles.kjv: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.
controles.livre: Fala a Arão, e dize-lhe: O homem de tua semente em suas gerações, no qual houver falta, não se achegará para oferecer o pão de seu Deus.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֥י כָל־אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בּ֥וֹ מ֖וּם לֹ֣א יִקְרָ֑ב אִ֤ישׁ עִוֵּר֙ א֣וֹ פִסֵּ֔חַ א֥וֹ חָרֻ֖ם א֥וֹ שָׂרֽוּעַ׃

controles.web: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,
controles.kjv: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,
controles.livre: Porque nenhum homem no qual houver falta, se achegará: homem cego, ou coxo, ou rosto mutilado, ou membro deformado,

versos.hebraico: א֣וֹ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖וֹ שֶׁ֣בֶר רָ֑גֶל א֖וֹ שֶׁ֥בֶר יָֽד׃

controles.web: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,
controles.kjv: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,
controles.livre: Ou homem no qual houver fratura de pé ou rotura da mão,

versos.hebraico: אֽוֹ־גִבֵּ֣ן אוֹ־דַ֔ק א֖וֹ תְּבַלֻּ֣ל בְּעֵינ֑וֹ א֤וֹ גָרָב֙ א֣וֹ יַלֶּ֔פֶת א֖וֹ מְר֥וֹחַ אָֽשֶׁךְ׃

controles.web: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.
controles.kjv: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;
controles.livre: Ou corcunda, ou anão, ou que tiver visão embaçada, ou que tenha sarna, ou impigem, ou testículo mutilado;

versos.hebraico: כָּל־אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בּ֣וֹ מ֗וּם מִזֶּ֨רַע֙ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן לֹ֣א יִגַּ֔שׁ לְהַקְרִ֖יב אֶת־אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מ֣וּם בּ֔וֹ אֵ֚ת לֶ֣חֶם אֱלֹהָ֔יו לֹ֥א יִגַּ֖שׁ לְהַקְרִֽיב׃

controles.web: No man of the seed of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.
controles.kjv: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the Lord made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.
controles.livre: Nenhum homem da descendência de Arão sacerdote, no qual houver falta, se achegará para oferecer as ofertas acendidas do SENHOR. Há falta nele; não se achegará a oferecer o pão de seu Deus.

versos.hebraico: לֶ֣חֶם אֱלֹהָ֔יו מִקָּדְשֵׁ֖י הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים וּמִן־הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים יֹאכֵֽל׃

controles.web: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.
controles.kjv: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.
controles.livre: O pão de seu Deus, do muito santo e as coisas santificadas, comerá.

versos.hebraico: אַ֣ךְ אֶל־הַפָּרֹ֜כֶת לֹ֣א יָבֹ֗א וְאֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ לֹ֥א יִגַּ֖שׁ כִּֽי־מ֣וּם בּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֤א יְחַלֵּל֙ אֶת־מִקְדָּשַׁ֔י כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃

controles.web: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”
controles.kjv: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the Lord do sanctify them.
controles.livre: Porém não entrará do véu dentro, nem se achegará ao altar, porquanto há falta nele: e não profanará meu santuário, porque eu o SENHOR sou o que os santifico.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְאֶל־בָּנָ֑יו וְאֶֽל־כָּל־בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

controles.web: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.
controles.livre: E Moisés falou isto a Arão, e a seus filhos, e a todos os filhos de Israel.
